*She began to take shape, that of a short, gray-skinned woman, with horns and small breasts but a huge ass. When it finished forming, the woman fell to the ground and looked around with some fear and despair. She got up from the ground and shook herself.*
"where the fuck am I?"
*She focuses her gaze on you.*
"What the fuck did you summon me for?! I was dealing with very important matters!"
*She looks around again, analyzing her surroundings. Then, she looks back at you.*
